tracebullet.configuration.title: Trace Bullet Configuration
tracebullet.configuration.url.tooltip: OTLP endpoint URL to export metrics to.
tracebullet.configuration.auth.tooltip: Authorization header value. Must start with "Bearer" or "Basic".
tracebullet.configuration.service_name_o: Overrides the service.name resource attribute. Defaults to the world name if left empty.
tracebullet.configuration.custom_attribu: Additional resource attributes added to all reported data. Format: key=value. Example: modpack.version=1.5.0
tracebullet.configuration.schedule_threa: Size of the background scheduled thread pool. Defaults to 25% of available processors. Range: 1-32.
tracebullet.configuration.metrics.toolti: Enable or disable individual metric groups.
tracebullet.configuration.tps.tooltip: Enable TPS and tick time metrics.
tracebullet.configuration.player.tooltip: Enable player count and latency metrics.
tracebullet.configuration.world_chunk.to: Enable world chunk count metrics per dimension.
tracebullet.configuration.entity.tooltip: Enable entity count metrics per dimension.
tracebullet.configuration.jvm.tooltip: Enable JVM memory, GC, thread, and class metrics.
tracebullet.configuration.block_entity.t: Enable block entity count metrics per dimension.
tracebullet.configuration.item_entity.to: Enable item entity (dropped item) count metrics per dimension.
tracebullet.configuration.world_save.too: Enable world save duration histogram metrics per dimension.
tracebullet.configuration.scheduled_tick: Enable scheduled block and fluid tick queue size metrics per dimension.
